summary.headline: Lords of the Year and Kings
summary.text: Chapters nine through eleven discuss the strength of the lord of the year, the lord of the ascendant as annual lord, and astrological judgments concerning kings, peasants, empire, and the significators derived from the Sun and midheaven.
